sourceRanges.use: Host/TreeSelect/tag/toolbar/row geometry and theme declarations, adapted to local .demo-multi-select scope instead of ShadowRoot.
Actual TreeSelect strict multi-check, all tag, source tag-fit calculation, search reset, minimum-width popup and informational toolbar.
Exactly six sales filter dimensions, status choices and SALE versus RETURN_EXCHANGE presentation groups; original data bridge excluded.

reuse: Existing transfer MultiSelect extracted into one domain-neutral action and component CSS. Transfer keeps its own candidate loader/DatePicker behavior; sales adds a lightweight action-owned lazy/exclusive shell and native-reference adapter.
intentionalDifferences: Empty values always display all/unrestricted. Frozen transient zero-selected display with an unrestricted query is not copied.

Exact ALL minus one only when one unsearched response proves the complete universe. Incomplete/filtered/multi-page candidates show a limitation, then a separately explicit Only this item action can start a positive subset. No excluded-ID API or catalog enumeration.
The native reference API lists authorized historical observations, not the source enabled/current master catalogs.

Remote search is the existing literal name substring (plus customer code), not an approximation of complete catalog ID/pinyin/initial matching. Static status/business choices retain known pinyin aliases.
Current source order is retained for finite enum options. Paginated remote candidate order is server-owned, and no all-catalog ordering parity is claimed.
Reset remains the existing draft-only operation and explicit Query remains required, unlike the frozen reset which queries immediately.
verificationBoundary: Source hashes, Node/React-JSDOM lifecycle tests and emitted static graphs only. No real-browser geometry/pixels, performance, PostgreSQL or production acceptance.
